hero.title: How DogBreedID sees a dog
hero.description: Explore the computer vision pipeline, deep convolutional neural networks, transfer learning fine-tuning, and Grad-CAM interpretability.

pipeline.title: End-to-End Classification Flow
pipeline.subtitle: From raw image matrix input to calibrated Top-5 probability predictions.

preprocessing.title: Image Preprocessing & Normalization
preprocessing.subtitle: Before feeding pixels into deep convolutional layers, images undergo standard matrix transformations.
preprocessing.step1Desc: Raw input photo submitted by user in JPG or PNG format.
preprocessing.step2Desc: Bilinear interpolation resizes image to uniform 224x224 resolution.
preprocessing.step3Desc: Standardized using ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and std [0.229, 0.224, 0.225].
preprocessing.step4Desc: Batch shape (1, 3, 224, 224) ready for CNN forward pass execution.

hierarchy.title: Hierarchical Feature Learning
hierarchy.subtitle: CNNs learn increasingly abstract representations across network depth.
hierarchy.g1Desc: Early layers detect low-level color gradients, orientation, and edge boundaries.
hierarchy.g2Desc: Mid-level layers identify fur coat patterns, nose textures, and eye contours.
hierarchy.g3Desc: Deeper layers assemble ears, muzzle shape, skull geometry, and eye positions.
hierarchy.g4Desc: Final feature maps encode fine-grained breed distinctions across 120 target classes.

gradCam.title: Understanding AI Attention
gradCam.description: Grad-CAM uses gradients flowing into the final convolutional layer to produce a coarse localization map highlighting important regions for predicting a concept.
gradCam.disclaimer: Scientific Disclaimer: Grad-CAM serves as an interpretability visual tool, not proof of exact human reasoning.

onnx.title: Deployment Acceleration
onnx.description: Trained PyTorch weights are exported to Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) format for hardware-optimized CPU/GPU web inference latency.
